content: MK argues that the letters as presented in MS Sinā 316 and MS Dānishgāh 2576 follow a rough chronological order beginning after Ibn Turka's return to Iran from Cairo in ca. 810/1408. He thinks the first letter, which speaks of departing Isfahan for the Hijaz, is unlikely to mark the start of his studies abroad and rather suggests a pilgrimage made in his first period in Shiraz and Isfahan (ca. 810-17/1408-14), under the patronage first of Pīr Muḥammad b. ʿUmar Shaykh and then of Iskandar b. ʿUmar Shaykh.
